cards.title: Math.max and Math.min
cards.body: `Math.max(4, 9, 2)` gives the biggest number. Put `...` before an array to pass its items: `Math.max(...nums)`.

cards.title: Spreading an array
cards.body: `...nums` spreads an array out into separate values, as if you had typed them one by one.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: Among negative numbers, the one closest to zero is the largest.

exercise.prompt: Read whole numbers on one line, separated by spaces, and print the largest.
exercise.starterCode:
const nums = prompt().split(" ").map(Number);
// print the largest number
